tagline: Revitalize & Balance with Kabira Skincare Rose Mist Toner
intro: Introducing your new favorite skincare step: the Kabira Skincare Mist Toner. This versatile 100 ml spray combines the essential benefits of a toner with the convenience of a refreshing facial mist. It’s the perfect solution for skin that needs balance, deep hydration, and a midday pick-me-up.
Our advanced formula features two powerhouse ingredients
Niacinamide (Vitamin B3): A cell-communicating superstar that helps minimize the look of pores and manage oil production, promoting clearer, healthier skin.
Hyaluronic Acid: A moisture magnet that draws water into the skin, preventing trans-epidermal water loss and ensuring lasting plumpness and hydration.

The delicate Rose infusion (implied by the beautiful rose on the packaging) helps to instantly soothe and cool the skin, restoring its natural balance and preparing it for better absorption of subsequent serums and moisturizers.

p: Toning Step: Spray onto a cotton pad or directly onto the face after cleansing to remove traces of impurities and balance pH.
Hydration Mist: Spritz over makeup during the day for a refreshing boost and a dewy finish.
Pre-Serum Prep: Apply to damp skin before serum to enhance product absorption.
